content.description: Lightweight rubric for evaluating whether document extraction output is structurally useful for downstream chunking and embedding.
quality_checks: The output should preserve visible text content in readable markdown.
The output should include image-derived content only when a vision model is used.
The output should avoid markdown fences and unnecessary wrapper noise.
The output should expose uncertainty when the image or page is unreadable.
The normalized result should be usable for downstream chunking.
content.acceptance_rule: Accept when the extracted markdown is readable, structurally useful, and grounded in the visible source content.
content.warning_rule: Warn when image markers exist without vision expansion or when the content is too weak after normalization.
